reason: I already find creators by DMing them and I mostly pay in free product, not $500 cash. A marketplace built around paid cash packages doesn't match how I do this, and I'm not paying a fee on top for something I can do myself.
objection: Why pay a platform fee when I can DM creators myself? And the follower counts and results aren't verified, so I'd still have to vet everyone the same way I do now.
would_change_my_mind: If I could post product-for-content (gifting) deals on it and still get the escrow and promo-code tracking, with verified follower counts.
